authority: CEO R324 §P1 — buyer experiment contracts for all 8 EXPERIMENT_READY candidates

P-02.claim: Adaptive valve profile reduces ICP excursion by 47.3% vs fixed-pressure valve
P-02.current_evidence: MODELLED — computational simulation shows 47.3% ICP offset reduction (R308)
P-02.unknown: No physical bench validation. Real valve dynamics may differ from simulation.
P-02.exact_experiment: Bench: adaptive valve vs fixed valve (Medtronic Strata) in mock CSF loop. Simulate postural changes (supine→upright→supine). Measure ICP excursion.
P-02.sample_size: 10 runs per valve type × 5 postural scenarios = 50 runs per valve
P-02.measured_endpoint: ICP excursion (peak-to-trough mmHg) and time above 20 mmHg (seconds)
P-02.preregistered_pass: Adaptive ICP excursion < 60% of fixed (≥40% reduction)
P-02.preregistered_fail: Adaptive ICP excursion ≥ 80% of fixed (<20% reduction)
P-02.ambiguous_result: 20-40% reduction → repeat with 20 runs per scenario for statistical power
P-02.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → pre-clinical. FAIL → REPAIR (redesign profile) → if fails again CEMETERY.

P-04.claim: Immobilized NEP enzyme achieves 100% Aβ42 clearance via mass-transport-limited contact time
P-04.current_evidence: MODELLED — R308 simulation shows 100% Aβ clearance (R277: 4/8 engineering frozen, 4/8 biology blocked)
P-04.unknown: Enzyme kinetics in CSF-like conditions. Enzyme stability over 30 days. Whether mass-transport limit holds in real geometry.
P-04.exact_experiment: In vitro: NEP-coated catheter segment in Aβ42-spiked artificial CSF (37°C, 72h). Measure Aβ42 concentration at 0, 24, 72h.
P-04.sample_size: 5 NEP-coated + 5 uncoated control, 3 time points each
P-04.ambiguous_result: 50-80% clearance → test enzyme stability (is it deactivating?) → repeat with fresh enzyme
P-04.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model. FAIL → REPAIR (BACE2 or increase loading) → if fails CEMETERY.

P-07.claim: Safety-floor drainage module maintains >0.1 mL/min during 70% obstruction
P-07.current_evidence: MODELLED — extracted from P-04 safety module, not independently manufactured
P-07.unknown: Whether safety floor activates correctly in real geometry. Flow rate through floor under partial obstruction.
P-07.exact_experiment: Bench: catheter with safety floor vs without, in mock CSF loop. Introduce 70% obstruction. Measure drainage rate and ICP.
P-07.measured_endpoint: Drainage rate (mL/min) and ICP (mmHg) during obstruction
P-07.preregistered_pass: Safety floor maintains drainage >0.1 mL/min during 70% obstruction
P-07.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE. FAIL → REPAIR (increase floor diameter) → if fails CEMETERY.

P-10.claim: Phase-change valve (n-octadecane) responds in <5s to ICP change
P-10.current_evidence: MODELLED — R320 repair: n-octadecane predicted 0.34s (from 15x ΔT speedup vs n-eicosane)
P-10.unknown: Real phase-change dynamics in valve assembly. Thermal mass of full valve. Heat transfer in CSF environment.
P-10.exact_experiment: Bench: n-octadecane valve in mock CSF loop. Apply pressure step (10→30 mmHg). Measure valve response time.
P-10.measured_endpoint: Valve response time (seconds from pressure step to flow change)
P-10.ambiguous_result: 5.0-6.0s → test with different thermal masses (is thermal mass the bottleneck?)
P-10.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE. FAIL → CEMETERY (repair budget exhausted: n-eicosane failed R308, n-octadecane failed R324).

P-11.claim: S. aureus phage K + Ti surface + electrospun coating prevents biofilm formation
P-11.current_evidence: MODELLED — R308 evidence chain (phage K identified, Ti substrate, electrospun coating)
P-11.unknown: Phage stability on Ti surface in CSF. Biofilm prevention in realistic S. aureus challenge.
P-11.exact_experiment: In vitro: phage-coated Ti catheter vs uncoated in S. aureus biofilm assay (7 days, 37°C).
P-11.measured_endpoint: Biofilm mass (crystal violet OD570) and CFU count
P-11.ambiguous_result: 20-50% → test phage stability (is phage deactivating in CSF?) → repeat with stabilizer
P-11.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model. FAIL → REPAIR (phage cocktail) → if fails CEMETERY.

P-12.claim: Cathepsin D enzyme clears tau protein from CSF via catheter wall immobilization
P-12.current_evidence: MODELLED — R308 simulation shows 100% tau clearance
P-12.unknown: Enzyme kinetics in CSF. Tau substrate accessibility. Enzyme stability.
P-12.exact_experiment: In vitro: Cathepsin D-coated catheter in tau-spiked aCSF (72h, 37°C). Measure tau concentration.
P-12.ambiguous_result: 50-80% → test enzyme kinetics (is substrate limiting?) → repeat with higher tau concentration
P-12.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model. FAIL → REPAIR (IDE enzyme) → if fails CEMETERY.

P-13.claim: Neuromorphic predictor forecasts shunt failure 24h before clinical symptoms
P-13.current_evidence: MODELLED — R308 conditional PASS (depends on P-15/P-16 energy)
P-13.unknown: Prediction accuracy on real patient data. Lead time in clinical setting.
P-13.exact_experiment: Retrospective: train predictor on existing shunt patient dataset (ICP + flow + outcomes). Test on held-out cohort.
P-13.measured_endpoint: AUC (area under ROC) and lead time (hours before symptom onset)
P-13.ambiguous_result: AUC 0.70-0.80 → collect more training data or test on external cohort
P-13.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → prospective clinical study. FAIL → REPAIR (multimodal model) → if fails CEMETERY.

P-20.claim: IL-10 release from PLGA matrix sustains ≥0.1 ng/cm²/day for 30 days in CSF
P-20.current_evidence: MODELLED — R316 simulation: 2468 ng/cm²/day at day 30 (24,680x above threshold)
P-20.unknown: Actual PLGA degradation in CSF. IL-10 stability in CSF. Glycan surface density degradation.
P-20.exact_experiment: In vitro: PLGA-IL-10 coated catheter segments in aCSF (37°C, 30 days). Measure IL-10 release and glycan density.
P-20.measured_endpoint: IL-10 concentration (ng/mL) at days 1, 7, 14, 30; cumulative release; glycan density (molecules/cm²)
P-20.preregistered_pass: IL-10 ≥0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 AND glycan ≥10¹²/cm² AND total <10 µmol/cm² (toxicity)
P-20.preregistered_fail: IL-10 <0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 OR toxicity exceeded
P-20.ambiguous_result: Meets threshold for 15 days but drops by day 30 → redesign loading (2x or dual-layer)
P-20.decision_consequence: PASS → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → pre-clinical animal model. FAIL → REPAIR (switch PLGA to PLA or PCL) → if fails CEMETERY. AMBIGUOUS → redesign loading.
